metadata.title: Institutions of the Indian Legislature
metadata.description: Institutional structure of the Union Parliament and State Legislatures of India.

institutions.name: Indian Legislature
institutions.description: The legislative framework of India, comprising the Union Legislature and the Legislatures of the States.

institutions.name: Union Legislature
institutions.description: The legislative institution at the Union level of India.

institutions.name: Parliament of India
institutions.description: The Union Legislature of India, constitutionally consisting of the President and two Houses: the Council of States and the House of the People.

institutions.name: President of India
institutions.description: The constitutional head of the Union and a constituent component of Parliament under Article 79.

institutions.name: House of the People
institutions.description: The lower House of Parliament, consisting of representatives directly elected by the people, subject to constitutional provisions.

institutions.name: Council of States
institutions.description: The upper House of Parliament, representing the States and Union Territories through its constitutionally prescribed composition.

institutions.name: State Legislature
institutions.description: The legislative institution of an Indian State, consisting of the Governor and either one or two legislative Houses, depending on the State's constitutional arrangement.

institutions.name: Governor
institutions.description: The constitutional head of a State and a constituent component of its Legislature under Article 168.

institutions.name: Legislative Assembly
institutions.description: The directly elected House of a State Legislature. Every State has a Legislative Assembly.

institutions.name: Legislative Council
institutions.description: The upper House of a bicameral State Legislature. It exists only in States where it has been established under the Constitution.

institutions.name: Lok Sabha Secretariat
institutions.description: The administrative and procedural establishment supporting the functioning of the Lok Sabha and its presiding officers.

institutions.name: Rajya Sabha Secretariat
institutions.description: The administrative and procedural establishment supporting the functioning of the Rajya Sabha and its presiding officers.

institutions.name: State Legislative Assembly Secretariat
institutions.description: The administrative establishment supporting the functioning of a State Legislative Assembly.

institutions.name: State Legislative Council Secretariat
institutions.description: The administrative establishment supporting the functioning of a State Legislative Council, wherever such a Council exists.
